page_title: INT 4-0 UDI | Inter v Udinese 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Marco Silvestri steps in and intercepts a long pass from Lautaro Martinez (Inter).
90+2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
86' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Jordan Zemura and he is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
86' Substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) on for Martin Payero.
84' 4 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
84' Carlos Augusto (Inter) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
80' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefano Sensi (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
79' Gabriele Cioffi is stunned as referee Marco Di Bello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
79' Total attempts – 16:9. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 7:1.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Thauvin (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Lorenzo Lucca.
74' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
74' Now Udinese have a corner.
73' Matteo Darmian (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

72' Carlos Augusto (Inter) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left post, but Marco Silvestri pulls off a fine save to deny him.
71' Here is a change. Federico Dimarco is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Juan Cuadrado (Inter).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakan Calhanoglu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
69' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
69' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
64' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
62' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Festy Ebosele is replaced by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Lazar Samardzic cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' The attendance is 71874.
60' Martin Payero (Udinese) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
59' Walace (Udinese) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
56' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
56' The referee signals a substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Bastoni.
55' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries to find Lautaro Martinez, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
51' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Martin Payero (Udinese).
49' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
47' Yann Bisseck (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' This would have been a magnificent goal from Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Henrikh Mkhitaryan plays it into the box, and Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 3:0.
42' 2 - 0 What a hit! Federico Dimarco (Inter) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
41' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
41' A quickly taken corner by Inter.

41' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Silvestri into the bottom left corner.
37' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Referee Marco Di Bello halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Simone Inzaghi, then shows him a yellow.
36' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

34' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
33' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
33' The ball rebounds out to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
33' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
31' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
28' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
27' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:2. 2:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
25' What an opportunity! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
24' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) sends a long ball forward to Lorenzo Lucca, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
22' Marcus Thuram (Inter) anticipates the cross from Alessandro Bastoni, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
19' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.

15' Lazar Samardzic sprays a wonderful pass out to Roberto Pereyra (Udinese), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Yann Sommer problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
15' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) on the edge of the box.
13' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

13' Federico Dimarco (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Marco Silvestri is alert and denies him with a nice save.
12' Nicolo Barella (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

10' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
9' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
8' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Inter get a corner.
4' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Di Bello no option but to blow his whistle.
1' Marcus Thuram (Inter) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the right side of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Di Bello.
